subject: Post-call: stakeholder intake — security & procurement handoffs
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emma Park <emma@cloudlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Oct 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: stakeholder intake — security & procurement handoffs

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and asks so we can move this forward: 

Recap:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for serving clinical-document summarization (pilot) with predictable latency and auditability.
- Primary success criteria you called out: 99th pct latency < 300ms, SOC2 evidence for pilot data pipeline, and a path to predictable unit costs for production.
- Pilot scope: 3 teams (Clinical NLP, Data Platform, Security), 6-week pilot, sample dataset (de-identified clinical notes).

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you share a simple org chart (or list) of the stakeholders who need to sign off for pilot and production? Specifically: economic buyer, procurement contact, security/compliance owner, and the engineering sponsor.
2) Who should we bring into a short security sync? We typically do a 30-min technical-security call (SOC2, data residency, KMS/HSM, logging/audit) — would like a primary and backup contact.
3) Procurement timeline and PO requirements (any mandatory contract language or templates).
4) Any formal decision criteria or weighting we should be aware of beyond the items above?

Proposed next steps: once we have the org/stakeholder list we will:
- Share a one-page Mutual Action Plan and a short security checklist (SOC2 artifacts + telemetry examples).
- Proposed security sync: Thu 11/2 or Fri 11/3 (30 minutes).

I attached a short template (we used on other pilots) that shows the information we need; happy to pre-fill if you prefer.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our solutions lead if you confirm a security attendee.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: Redwood-MAP-template.pdf (1 page)

Thanks, Sofia — appreciate the clear recap. High level answers below and I attached our light IT org chart for now.

Quick answers:
- Economic buyer: Raj Kapoor (CTO) — cc’d.
- Engineering sponsor: me (Director, Clinical NLP).
- Procurement contact: procurement@cloudlinehealth.com (we use a centralized PO process).
- Security / compliance owner for pilot: Maya Singh (Sr. Manager, InfoSec) — I’ll introduce separately on the security sync.
- Decision criteria: latency & stability, SOC2 evidence + log access, and an option to deploy in our VPC if needed for production.

Procurement timeline: typically 2–4 weeks once SOW pricing is agreed; we need standard security attestations and an approved vendor registration form.

I attached: Cloudline-IT-Orgchart.pdf (1 page). I’ll follow up with Maya on availability for a Thu/Fri security sync — our preference is Thu 11/2 morning PT.

—Emma
